modelAnswer:
In a class discussion, I was invited to explain the meaning of my name. My heart pounded, the old fear of being judged slowly returning. I nearly brushed it aside, as I always had. Then I took a deep breath, determined to do it differently. "Qiuyu means autumn rain," I said softly. I told them how, in my hometown, autumn rain falls gently, washing the world clean and bringing a fresh start. As I spoke, my voice grew steadier.
Many of my classmates got interested and came up to me after class. One girl said my name sounded like a poem; another asked me to write the characters down. Surrounded by their curious smiles, I felt something warm rise in my chest. I had hidden my name to avoid trouble, yet now it was quietly building bridges. Like the autumn rain it carried, my name had washed away my fear and let a part of my culture grow abroad.

continuationDesign.theme: 名字不是要藏起的负担，而是分享文化身份、连接彼此的桥梁。
paragraphs: 第1段承接 starter1「被邀请解释名字含义」：先把它当既成事实接住，立刻让原文的「怕被评判」心理(in care about how others think)以"the old fear...slowly returning"回潮，并用"as I always had"回扣原文她惯常的回避(smile and nod)；再用一句深呼吸的关键过渡逆转决定，制造"回避惯性 vs 这次不同"的内在冲突。线索上直接调用原文真实给出的名字含义 Qiuyu=秋雨，把它解码成 autumn rain 并落到家乡意象，完成从"停止当 Chinese teacher"到主动分享的转折，为第2段蓄势。

第2段承接 starter2「同学课后围上来」：先以两个具体细节(夸名字像诗、请写汉字)把抽象的"产生兴趣"坐实，呼应原文她原本怕同学"grow tired/lose patience"——如今恰是相反的热情回应。情绪由怕转暖(something warm rise in my chest)，并正面回收原文的未解矛盾：她曾藏名字"to avoid trouble"，对照原文"losing...the opportunity to share my cultural identity"，此刻名字反而"building bridges"。结尾用 autumn rain 作明喻点题——名字像它承载的秋雨般洗去恐惧、让文化在异乡生长，意象严格回扣原文真有的 Qiuyu(秋雨)。

highlightExpressions.text: My heart pounded, the old fear of being judged slowly returning.
highlightExpressions.note: 心理描写+独立主格(逗号后 the old fear...slowly returning 为独立主格作伴随状语)。写"某种情绪悄悄袭来/回潮"的高分句式，可迁移到紧张、羞怯、希望等情绪的隐性涌现。

highlightExpressions.text: Then I took a deep breath, determined to do it differently.
highlightExpressions.note: 动作+形容词作状语(determined 作伴随状语表决心)。写人物下定决心、由犹豫转行动的转折过渡句，可迁移到任何"鼓起勇气做某事"的关键节点。

highlightExpressions.text: autumn rain falls gently, washing the world clean and bringing a fresh start
highlightExpressions.note: 环境烘托+现在分词并列作结果/伴随状语(washing...and bringing...)。把意象动态化并赋予象征义的写法，可迁移到用景物动作映衬心境或主题升华。

highlightExpressions.text: Surrounded by their curious smiles, I felt something warm rise in my chest.
highlightExpressions.note: 过去分词作状语(Surrounded by...置于句首)+心理描写。写"被某种氛围包围、内心涌起暖意/感动"的句式，可迁移到被善意、掌声、温暖包围的正向情绪场景。

highlightExpressions.text: Like the autumn rain it carried, my name had washed away my fear and let a part of my culture grow abroad.
highlightExpressions.note: 明喻点题句+过去完成时收束。借核心意象作比、回扣主旨的升华结尾，可迁移到结尾用原文中心物象作喻、呼应主题、完成情感升华。
